    WHY KONFIDAS?

    At Konfidas, we’re on a mission to help organizations plan, protect, manage and adopt a proactive cybersecurity mindset. Our experts harness their multidisciplinary experience to combine a cutting-edge, offensive approach with a high-level, pragmatic, business-oriented defense to enhance your cybersecurity readiness.

    Read More

    24/7
    MANAGED
    CYBERSECURITY
    SERVICES/7

     Using our deep expertise, experience with diverse clients, and close proximity to the world’s cybersecurity hub (Israel), we evaluate and implement enterprise-grade security at affordable prices, around the globe and around the clock. We provide expert monitoring, regulatory compliance and insurance guidance you can count on, to mitigate and resolve cyber threats to your organisation. 

    Read More

    OUR CONSULTING 
    SOLUTIONS

    Konfidas was established in 2013 with the goal of providing best-in-class cybersecurity and data protection consulting and services to medium and large organizations in Israel and globally.  Konfidas has since expanded to serve a wide array of smaller businesses and start-ups, providing them with the same high-level and tailored cyber solutions.
